mapper.insert: INSERT INTO post_appeal (user_id, post_id, post_title, post_content, reason, status, appeal_time) VALUES (#{userId}, #{postId}, #{postTitle}, #{postContent}, #{reason}, 0, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, post_id, post_title, post_content, reason, status, appeal_time, review_time, reviewer_id FROM post_appeal WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY appeal_time DESC
SELECT id, user_id, post_id, post_title, post_content, reason, status, appeal_time, review_time, reviewer_id FROM post_appeal WHERE status = 0 ORDER BY appeal_time ASC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM post_appeal WHERE status = 0
